docs.title: rzk-project-template
docs.text: Template for a formalisation project in rzk proof assistant.

docs.title: How to check
docs.text:
From the root of the project's repository, run:

rzk typecheck src/**/*.rzk.md

docs.title: Example formalisation module
docs.text:
#lang rzk-1

Here is an identity function:

#define identity
    ( A : U)
    : A → A
    := \ x → x
